descriptions: Fixed citizen search timing out after 15000 ms when a query failed or Config.Licenses did not match the framework
Fixed tablet requests hanging until the timeout on server errors, the real error is now shown in the server console
Fixed citizen profile and nearby citizens failing when the license table is missing
Fixed the tablet ignoring the player's chosen language
Fixed on-duty hours being lost on resource restart
Fixed announcements not refreshing for other workers
Fixed sidebar groups closing on their own
Improved server-side validation of gallery photos, profile images and statuses
Fixed medical history and tag audit logs missing their author
Improved stability, a page error no longer closes the whole tablet
